'''Fuchsia City''' has the famous [[Safari Zone]], and can be access West by [[Route 18]], East by [[Route 15]], and South by [[Route 19]] (require Surf).

This city contains Fuchsia City's Gym, with Koga as its leader. Players who obtained the Soul Badge will be able to use Strength outside of battle.

==Points of Interest==
===Exp. All===
On the second floor of the Gate to [[Route 15]] is the Professor Oak's assistant. If the player has fused at least 20 times, she will give an {{ItemIcon|EXPALL}} Exp. All.

===Hidden Ability Outbreak Locator===
The house left of the Pokémon Center has an elderly woman with a sleeping Musharna that can locate Outbreaks where wild Pokémon can be caught with their [[Hidden Abilities]]. The elderly woman will tell the player the location of the ongoing Outbreak.

===Iron Head Tutor===
A man in the Pokémon Center will teach [[bulbapedia:Iron Head (move)|Iron Head]] to the player's Pokémon for {{P$}}3,000.
